fields.Name: GetConversationComplete
fields.UserQuestion: What are all the messages, agent runs, and artifacts for this conversation?
fields.Description: Returns complete conversation data in a single query: all messages with their related agent runs and artifacts aggregated as JSON. Optimized for fast conversation loading.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Single-query optimization that replaces 4 separate queries (messages, agent runs, artifact map, batch artifacts/versions). Uses SQL Server FOR JSON PATH to aggregate related data as JSON columns. Agent runs and artifacts are returned as JSON arrays per conversation detail, avoiding row multiplication from JOINs. Client parses JSON and reconstructs objects. Reduces network round trips from 4 to 1 for ~70% faster conversation loading. Excludes heavy Content field from artifacts for performance.

fields.Name: ConversationID
fields.Description: Unique identifier of the conversation to load complete details for.

fields.Name: ExternalID
fields.Description: External system identifier for this message, used for integration scenarios.

fields.Name: Role
fields.Description: The role of the message sender (user, assistant, system, function).

fields.Name: Message
fields.Description: The actual content of the message in the conversation.

fields.Name: Error
fields.Description: Error message if this conversation turn encountered a problem.

fields.Name: HiddenToUser
fields.Description: Flag indicating if this message should be hidden from end users (system messages, function calls, etc.).

fields.Name: UserRating
fields.Description: This column is used to capture user feedback as a rating scale. The scale ranges from 1 to 10, where 1 might represent thumbs down, and 10 might represent thumbs up or the highest rating in a star-based scale.

fields.Name: UserFeedback
fields.Description: This column is used to store user text feedback about a given AI response, describing what they liked or disliked.

fields.Name: ReflectionInsights
fields.Description: This column stores human or AI-generated reflections on how to improve future responses based on the user feedback and the AI output generated for prior messages in the conversation.

fields.Name: SummaryOfEarlierConversation
fields.Description: This column optionally stores a summary of the entire conversation leading up to this particular conversation detail record. It is used in long-running conversations to optimize performance by summarizing earlier parts.

fields.Name: UserID
fields.Description: This field, when populated, overrides the UserID at the Conversation level to specify a different user created the message.

fields.Name: ArtifactID
fields.Description: Optional reference to a conversation artifact associated with this conversation detail

fields.Name: ArtifactVersionID
fields.Description: Optional reference to a specific version of a conversation artifact associated with this conversation detail

fields.Name: CompletionTime
fields.Description: Duration in milliseconds representing how long the AI response processing took to complete for this conversation detail.

fields.Name: IsPinned
fields.Description: Indicates if this message is pinned within the conversation for easy reference

fields.Name: ParentID
fields.Description: Optional reference to parent message for threaded conversations. NULL for top-level messages.

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Denormalized agent ID for quick lookup of agent name and icon without joining through AgentRun

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Status of the conversation message. Complete indicates finished processing, In-Progress indicates active agent work, Error indicates processing failed.

fields.Name: SuggestedResponses
fields.Description: DEPRECATED: Use ResponseForm, ActionableCommands, and AutomaticCommands instead. Legacy field for simple text-based suggested responses. Replaced in v2.118 by more powerful structured forms and commands system. Retained for historical data only.

fields.Name: TestRunID
fields.Description: Optional Foreign Key - Links this conversation detail to a test run if this message was part of a test conversation. Allows filtering and analyzing test-specific conversation turns.

fields.Name: ResponseForm
fields.Description: JSON object containing agent response form definition with questions and validation rules. Supports 8 question types: text, textarea, email, number, currency, date, datetime, choices (buttongroup/radio/dropdown/checkbox). Used for collecting structured user input with proper validation.

fields.Name: ActionableCommands
fields.Description: JSON array of actionable commands that user can trigger (shown as clickable buttons/links). Supports open:resource (navigate to records/dashboards/reports/forms) and open:url (external links). Typically used after completing work to provide easy navigation to created/modified resources.

fields.Name: AutomaticCommands
fields.Description: JSON array of automatic commands that execute immediately when received (no user interaction). Supports refresh:data (refresh entity data or caches) and notification (show toast messages). Used for keeping UI in sync after agent makes changes and providing user feedback.

fields.Name: OriginalMessageChanged
fields.Description: Indicates if the original message content was modified after initial creation. Set automatically by the server when the Message field is changed on update.

fields.Name: AgentSessionID
fields.Description: Links this message to the AIAgentSession that was active when it was created. NULL for messages typed in standard text chat outside any live session. Lets the conversation timeline group a sessions messages into a single collapsible block.

fields.Name: TurnEndedAt
fields.Description: Immutable timestamp marking when this turn ended/finalized. Set once on turn completion (do NOT read __mj_UpdatedAt for this — it moves on later edits). Paired with __mj_CreatedAt (turn start) and AIAgentSession.RecordingStartedAt (t0) to derive audio seek offsets.

fields.Name: UtteranceStartMs
fields.Description: Precise media-relative start of this turn, in integer milliseconds from the recording t0 (AIAgentSession.RecordingStartedAt). Populated only when the realtime driver supplies frame timing; NULL otherwise (fall back to __mj_CreatedAt - t0). Used by the evidence player for click-to-seek.

fields.Name: UtteranceEndMs
fields.Description: Precise media-relative end of this turn, in integer milliseconds from the recording t0 (AIAgentSession.RecordingStartedAt). Populated only when the realtime driver supplies frame timing; NULL otherwise. Used by the evidence player for click-to-seek.

fields.Name: MediaType
fields.Description: Modality of this turn's content: Text, Audio, or Video. Forward-compat so video turns reuse the same record shape when realtime models support it. NULL = text (legacy default).

fields.Name: Sequence
fields.Description: Monotonic, per-conversation ordinal assigned on insert (1-based). Provides a stable symbolic handle used by conversation-history retrieval tools and by the sequence markers embedded in compaction summaries. A summary stored in SummaryOfEarlierConversation on a given row covers all rows with a lower Sequence in the same conversation.

fields.Name: BranchID
fields.Description: The fork this message belongs to. NULL means Main (the trunk). Every writer sets it explicitly.

fields.Name: ReplacedAt
fields.Description: When a rerun of this message's turn replaced it (Regenerate or Save and resend while forking is off). A replaced row is kept for audit, is hidden from the user and is never sent to an agent. NULL means the row is live.

fields.Name: UserImageURL
fields.Description: URL for the user's avatar image

fields.Name: UserImageIconClass
fields.Description: CSS icon class for the user's avatar

fields.Name: AgentRunsJSON
fields.Description: JSON array containing AI agent execution runs associated with the conversation detail
fields.ComputationDescription: Subquery formatted FOR JSON PATH aggregating records from [__mj].[vwAIAgentRuns]

fields.Name: ArtifactsJSON
fields.Description: JSON array containing artifact output versions associated with the conversation detail
fields.ComputationDescription: Subquery formatted FOR JSON PATH joining [vwConversationDetailArtifacts], [vwArtifactVersions], and [vwArtifacts]

fields.Name: RatingsJSON
fields.Description: JSON array containing user ratings and feedback for the conversation detail
fields.ComputationDescription: Subquery formatted FOR JSON PATH joining [vwConversationDetailRatings] and [vwUsers]
